annotations.identification: the four distinctive ventilator-sash close pairs and the corner double-line of the south facade, pattern-matched between the drawing's mullion grid and the photo's detected vertical structure: photo pair (740, 760) = drawing vent sash 2 (ventPair2); photo pair (1146, 1166) = sash 3 (ventPair3); photo pair (1627, 1649) = sash 4 (ventPair4); photo pair (1769, 1775) = the SE corner double mullion (corner). The monotonically increasing local scale (0.68 -> 0.81 -> 0.89 photo-px per drawing-px eastward) is the obliquity gradient of the vantage (~24 deg, consistent across the two inter-sash spans); sash 1 is occluded by the elm. Levels: the floor edge (documented MAIN FLOOR EL. 2'-4") is the strongest horizontal edge (~y 1026, flat across the facade - the camera being near the main-floor level); the ceiling edge (documented CEILING EL. 11'-9") is the roof assembly's underside shadow line - selected over the glass-top edge by the documented-ratio consistency test (the glass-top reading would require cos(yaw) > 1 for any real facade view; the shadow-line reading yields the consistent obliquity). The drawing-side feature positions are resolved BY NAME from the tool's own detection of the committed raster (ventPairN = the Nth detected ventilator-sash close pair; corner = the corner double-line) - scale-independent, re-measured on every run.
